title: China-to-Zimbabwe Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety Under SAZ Adopted Standards
rows.target_requirement: Zimbabwe electrical safety for power tools is assessed against SAZ-administered ZWS standards that adopt IEC 62841 for hand-held and transportable motor-operated tools, generally aligned with SANS adoptions. The grid is 230 V, 50 Hz, so design ratings, insulation, and plug or charger input must suit 230 V even though the 50 Hz frequency matches China. Corded tools, and any separate charger, external power supply, or adapter for cordless tools, must each meet the adopted electrical safety requirements.
target_standards: ZWS / SAZ adoption of IEC 62841 series for hand-held and transportable motor-operated electric tools
SANS-aligned adoptions referenced through SAZ where applicable
Charger or power-supply electrical safety standards adopted via SAZ where in scope
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series （hand-held motor-operated electric tools） and separate charger standards where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence should be mapped to the SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 requirements and the 230 V supply rather than treated as automatic Zimbabwe acceptance.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is presenting a GB/T 3883 report tested for China 220/380 V conditions without confirming alignment to the SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 clauses and the Zimbabwe 230 V supply, and without separately covering the charger, adapter, or external power supply of cordless tools.

target.en: Adopted-standard obligation: SAZ/ZWS adoption of IEC 62841 is the reference safety basis, applied through national conformity and import inspection. The legal route is the Zimbabwe conformity and import-inspection framework; the adopted IEC 62841 standard is the technical basis used within it.
target.zh: 采纳标准义务：SAZ/ZWS 对 IEC 62841 的采纳是参考安全依据，通过国家符合性与进口检验适用。法律路径是津巴布韦符合性与进口检验框架；采纳的 IEC 62841 标准是其中使用的技术依据。
target.zht: 採納標準義務：SAZ/ZWS 對 IEC 62841 的採納是參考安全依據，通過國家符合性與進口檢驗適用。法律路徑是辛巴威符合性與進口檢驗框架；採納的 IEC 62841 標準是其中使用的技術依據。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series and charger-specific standards where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及适用的充电器专项标准。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及適用的充電器專項標準。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until the file confirms the tool body, and any charger or external power supply, meet the SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 safety basis at 230 V, 50 Hz rather than relying on a China 220/380 V GB/T 3883 report alone.

rows.target_requirement: Motor-driven power tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies can generate electromagnetic disturbance. Zimbabwe addresses EMC through SAZ-adopted IEC/CISPR-based standards （typically aligned with SANS adoptions） applied within national conformity and import inspection. For cordless tools with wireless or radio functions, POTRAZ type-approval covers the radio interface, which is a separate obligation from general EMC.
target_standards: SAZ/ZWS adoption of IEC/CISPR-based EMC standards, SANS-aligned where applicable
POTRAZ type-approval for the radio interface of cordless tools with wireless functions
Zimbabwe national conformity and import inspection framework
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. Test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and any wireless module still need Zimbabwe-specific review against SAZ-adopted EMC standards and, for radio functions, POTRAZ type-approval.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is an EMC report that tests only the bare tool but omits the charger, battery pack, controller variants, or worst-case load conditions, and a cordless tool with a wireless module that has no POTRAZ type-approval for the Zimbabwe radio interface.

target.en: Adopted-standard obligation applied through national conformity and import inspection for EMC; separate mandatory POTRAZ type-approval for cordless tools with radio or wireless functions. The SAZ-adopted EMC standards are the technical basis used within the conformity framework.
target.zh: EMC 为通过国家符合性与进口检验适用的采纳标准义务；带射频或无线功能的无绳工具另有强制的 POTRAZ 型号核准。SAZ 采纳的 EMC 标准是符合性框架内使用的技术依据。
target.zht: EMC 為通過國家符合性與進口檢驗適用的採納標準義務；帶射頻或無線功能的無繩工具另有強制的 POTRAZ 型號核准。SAZ 採納的 EMC 標準是符合性框架內使用的技術依據。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence, but Zimbabwe acceptance depends on scope, limits, configuration, and SAZ-adopted standard mapping, plus POTRAZ for radio functions.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据，但津巴布韦接受性取决于范围、限值、配置和 SAZ 采纳标准映射，射频功能还需 POTRAZ。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據，但辛巴威接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置和 SAZ 採納標準映射，射頻功能還需 POTRAZ。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Zimbabwe-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system against SAZ-adopted EMC standards and any cordless wireless function holds POTRAZ type-approval.

source.publisher: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

rows.requirement: Market Access Under SAZ Conformity and Import Inspection
rows.target_requirement: Electric and cordless power tools placed on the Zimbabwe market are assessed against SAZ-administered ZWS standards, which adopt IEC （and align with SANS）, applied through national conformity assessment and import inspection. Zimbabwe is landlocked, so most consignments route through Durban or Beira, and import inspection and documentation practice apply at entry. POTRAZ type-approval is required for cordless tools with radio functions, and the NSSA occupational framework governs workplace use.
target_standards: SAZ-administered ZWS standards adopting IEC 62841, SANS-aligned where applicable
Zimbabwe national conformity assessment and import inspection at entry
POTRAZ type-approval for cordless tools with radio functions
NSSA occupational safety and health framework for workplace use
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, with CCC where applicable for the domestic market. GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence does not replace Zimbabwe conformity assessment, import inspection clearance, or POTRAZ type-approval for radio functions.
china_standards: CCC where applicable for the China domestic market
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report alone is not enough for Zimbabwe placement. The importer needs conformity evidence mapped to SAZ-adopted standards, import-inspection documentation, POTRAZ type-approval for any cordless radio function, and attention to the landlocked routing via Durban or Beira.

target.en: Mandatory: national conformity assessment and import inspection against SAZ-adopted standards at entry; POTRAZ type-approval is mandatory for cordless tools with radio functions; NSSA occupational duties apply to workplace use.
target.zh: 强制：入境时按 SAZ 采纳标准进行国家合格评定与进口检验；带射频功能的无绳工具强制 POTRAZ 型号核准；NSSA 职业义务适用于工作场所使用。
target.zht: 強制：入境時按 SAZ 採納標準進行國家合格評定與進口檢驗；帶射頻功能的無繩工具強制 POTRAZ 型號核准；NSSA 職業義務適用於工作場所使用。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，适用时还有 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，適用時還有 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Zimbabwe-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence. SAZ-mapped conformity, import-inspection documentation, and POTRAZ type-approval for cordless radio functions are required.

rows.requirement: Noise: No EU-Style Outdoor Product Marking
rows.target_requirement: Zimbabwe does not operate an EU-style outdoor-equipment noise marking and conformity regime （there is no national equivalent of Directive 2000/14/EC requiring a guaranteed sound-power level mark on the product）. Noise is instead addressed where SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 test methods declare tool noise and vibration data, and through the NSSA occupational safety and health framework governing workplace exposure. There is no standalone Zimbabwe product-level outdoor-noise mark to obtain for power tools.
target_standards: No Zimbabwe equivalent of EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise product marking
SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 noise and vibration declaration test methods
NSSA occupational safety and health framework for workplace noise exposure
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and, in the relevant parts, includes noise and vibration declaration methods. China also has no obligation to obtain an EU-style outdoor-noise product mark, so on this point the China baseline and Zimbabwe practice are similar: declared data rather than a separate product noise mark.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series noise and vibration declaration parts where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly stated, there is little product-marking gap here because Zimbabwe has no EU-style outdoor-noise mark. The practical action is to keep declared noise and vibration data from the SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 test methods consistent in the manual, and to support employer NSSA occupational duties; exporters should not assume an EU 2000/14/EC-type mark is needed or available.

target.en: No mandatory Zimbabwe product-level outdoor-noise mark exists for power tools. Mandatory elements are the noise and vibration declaration within the SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 conformity basis and employer obligations under the NSSA occupational framework.
target.zh: 津巴布韦不存在针对电动工具的强制产品级户外噪声标识。强制内容是 SAZ 采纳的 IEC 62841 符合性依据中的噪声与振动声明，以及 NSSA 职业框架下的雇主义务。
target.zht: 辛巴威不存在針對電動工具的強制產品級戶外噪聲標識。強制內容是 SAZ 採納的 IEC 62841 符合性依據中的噪聲與振動聲明，以及 NSSA 職業框架下的雇主義務。

cn.en: China likewise has no EU-style outdoor-noise product mark; noise is handled through declared GB/T 3883 data where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国同样没有欧盟式户外噪声产品标识；噪声在适用时通过 GB/T 3883 声明数据处理。
cn.zht: 中國同樣沒有歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標識；噪聲在適用時通過 GB/T 3883 聲明數據處理。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Largely not a product-marking barrier: Zimbabwe has no EU-style outdoor-noise mark, so keep SAZ-adopted IEC 62841 declared noise and vibration data consistent and support NSSA occupational duties rather than seeking a 2000/14/EC-type mark that does not exist locally.

source.publisher: National Social Security Authority of Zimbabwe (NSSA)

rows.target_requirement: Zimbabwe does not operate a dedicated EU RoHS-equivalent restricted-substance regime for power tools enforced as a product mark. Material safety is addressed where SAZ-adopted IEC/SANS-aligned standards and general import inspection apply, and where adopted standards reference substance or material requirements. Exporters should keep material-traceability evidence available, but should not assume a Zimbabwe RoHS declaration in the EU sense is the gating requirement.
target_standards: No Zimbabwe product-mark RoHS regime equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU
SAZ-adopted IEC/SANS-aligned standards and import inspection where substance or material requirements are referenced
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files often include GB/T 3883 safety evidence and may include China RoHS material declarations where applicable. China RoHS material data can support due diligence, but Zimbabwe does not require an EU-style RoHS product declaration as a market gate.
china_standards: China RoHS material declarations where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly, restricted-substance documentation is less of a formal Zimbabwe gate than in the EU. The practical step is to retain homogeneous-material and supplier evidence for due diligence and any adopted-standard material clauses, without over-claiming a Zimbabwe RoHS mark that does not exist.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style RoHS product declaration in Zimbabwe for power tools. Substance or material requirements apply only where SAZ-adopted standards or import inspection reference them.
target.zh: 津巴布韦对电动工具没有欧盟式 RoHS 产品声明的强制要求。物质或材料要求仅在 SAZ 采纳标准或进口检验引用时适用。
target.zht: 辛巴威對電動工具沒有歐盟式 RoHS 產品聲明的強制要求。物質或材料要求僅在 SAZ 採納標準或進口檢驗引用時適用。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 material evidence supports due diligence but is not a Zimbabwe gating document.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 材料证据可支持尽职调查，但不是津巴布韦的关卡文件。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 材料證據可支援盡職調查，但不是辛巴威的關卡文件。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not a primary Zimbabwe barrier: there is no EU-style RoHS product declaration here, so retain material-traceability evidence for due diligence and any adopted-standard clauses rather than seeking a local RoHS mark that does not exist.

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Battery Safety and Radio Approval
rows.target_requirement: For cordless power tools, the battery pack and charger are assessed for safety through SAZ-adopted IEC standards （cell and battery safety, charger safety） applied within national conformity and import inspection. Zimbabwe does not operate an EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 equivalent （no battery passport, due-diligence, or removability product mark）. Where the cordless tool has wireless or radio functions, POTRAZ type-approval is required for the radio interface.
target_standards: SAZ-adopted IEC cell, battery, and charger safety standards
No Zimbabwe equivalent of EU Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542
POTRAZ type-approval for the radio interface of cordless tools with wireless functions
Zimbabwe national conformity and import inspection framework
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, or rely on separate lithium-battery safety and transport evidence. This evidence can support Zimbabwe battery-safety review, but a cordless tool with a wireless module still needs POTRAZ type-approval for the radio interface.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety and transport evidence where applicable
rows.gap: The main gap for cordless tools is not an EU-style battery passport （which Zimbabwe does not require） but missing POTRAZ type-approval for any wireless function, and battery or charger safety not mapped to the SAZ-adopted IEC standards at 230 V. Battery transport evidence alone does not cover the in-country safety and radio approvals.

target.en: Mandatory: battery and charger safety against SAZ-adopted IEC standards within conformity and import inspection, plus POTRAZ type-approval for cordless tools with radio functions. No EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542-style product obligations apply in Zimbabwe.
target.zh: 强制：在符合性与进口检验框架内按 SAZ 采纳的 IEC 标准评估电池与充电器安全，并对带射频功能的无绳工具进行 POTRAZ 型号核准。津巴布韦不适用欧盟电池法规 2023/1542 式产品义务。
target.zht: 強制：在符合性與進口檢驗框架內按 SAZ 採納的 IEC 標準評估電池與充電器安全，並對帶射頻功能的無繩工具進行 POTRAZ 型號核准。辛巴威不適用歐盟電池法規 2023/1542 式產品義務。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence supports safety review but does not by itself satisfy Zimbabwe in-country safety mapping or POTRAZ radio approval.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据可支持安全审查，但本身不能满足津巴布韦国内安全映射或 POTRAZ 射频核准。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據可支援安全審查，但本身不能滿足辛巴威國內安全映射或 POTRAZ 射頻核准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Zimbabwe-ready for cordless tools until the battery and charger meet SAZ-adopted IEC safety standards at 230 V and any wireless function holds POTRAZ type-approval; an EU 2023/1542-style battery passport is not required here.

source.publisher: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)
